tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is far beyond the pilot window, leaving slow adaptation and possible reversal unidentified. The slow-horizon probe directly addresses that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify both timescales or establish long-horizon behavior.
More fine short-window observations are less directly informative about the target horizon.
The pilot does not distinguish these long-horizon mechanisms from sink-coupled adaptation.
